The graph above shows $y=\operatorname{tan}⁡(Bx).$ What is the value of $B?$
question.worked_solution:
In order to find the value of $B,$ we first need to find the period of the function.

From the graph, we can see that function makes a complete cycle on the interval $(-\frac{7\pi }{12},\frac{7\pi }{12}).$ So, the period is $\frac{7\pi }{6}.$ 

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/linear/14254788/assets/20eafc2cbcd7fe467a8b58ccac4eb56075f834b5da6c57415318a18207966cca.png)

We know that for a function $y=\operatorname{tan}⁡(Bx),$ the horizontal scaling factor is $\frac{1}{B},$ and the period is multiplied by the scaling factor:

$$
\text{period}=\pi \cdot \frac{1}{B}
$$

For our particular function, the period is $\frac{7\pi }{6},$ so we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{7\pi }{6} & =\pi \cdot \frac{1}{B} \\ B & =\frac{6}{7}.\end{aligned}
$$
